messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod (us-east-1). Alert: gateway.5xx_rate > 10% over 5m. Symptoms: 502/504 and gateway timeouts; coincident errors from prefix-cache (KV) with 'invalid pointer' / 'decode error'. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/az-1795012345 :pager:
Jamie (oncall-sre): ack. I'm on the page. Who's closest to prefix-cache and runtime?
Maria (runtime): seeing spike starting ~00:14 UTC. Per-route 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Errors show up as NPE in prefix resolution layer.
Kunal (platform): I'm on infra. pulling logs from prefix-cache now.
Maria (runtime): quick log sample (latest stack frames):
```
java.lang.NullPointerException at com.redwood.runtime.prefix.PrefixResolver.resolve(PrefixResolver.java:142)
at com.redwood.runtime.model.RequestHandler.handle(RequestHandler.java:88)
..gateway -> 502
```
Kunal (platform): running quick command: `kubectl logs -l app=prefix-cache -n prod --since=10m | grep -i error | tail -n 40`
```
2026-03-15T00:14:12Z ERROR prefix-cache Failed to decode pointer for key pfx-abc123: checksum mismatch
2026-03-15T00:14:13Z WARN  prefix-cache tombstone seen for key pfx-xyz987
2026-03-15T00:14:13Z ERROR prefix-cache shadow-read returned empty pointer for key pfx-abc123
```
Zoe (support): seeing multiple customer tickets for 502s. Top customer affected: AcmeCorp (ticket #45212) reporting degraded API since 00:16 UTC. Support tl;dr: retries help but some requests permanently fail.
Jamie (oncall-sre): immediate mitigations: 1) enable routing fallback to smaller model 2) disable prefix-prefetch 3) scale prefix-cache replicas 4) invalidate suspect prefix shards. Who can run these?
Kunal (platform): doing 1 and 3 now. executing:
```
# set routing fallback
redwoodctl route update inference-gateway-prod --fallback-model redwood-small --apply
# scale prefix-cache
kubectl scale deployment/prefix-cache -n prod --replicas=5
```
deploy-bot: command accepted. Routing update applied. rollout id: r-1795012345-fallback. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: scaled deployment/prefix-cache to 5 replicas.
Maria (runtime): applying 2) disable prefetch for prefix-cache on prod config:
```
POST /config/prefix-cache {"prefetch_enabled": false}
```
Kunal (platform): toggled prefetch false, config commit id cfg-1795012345. Prefetch workers drained.
Maria (runtime): running quick health check against gateway after fallback + scale:
- 5xx rate dropped from ~18% to 1.2% in 6m. Latency improved. :thumbsup:
Zoe (support): posting a customer-facing blurb in #general-ops: "We're investigating elevated 502s affecting some requests. Temporary routing fallback applied; retries recommended. We'll update in 30m."
Jamie (oncall-sre): good. Next: invalidate suspect prefix shards to prevent shadow-read hits. We suspect a recent compaction run produced partially-applied tombstones that cause decode errors. Kunal, can you run targeted invalidation on keys with checksum mismatch?
Kunal (platform): running invalidation for prefix range pfx-2026-03-15-us-e1. Command:
```
prefixctl invalidate --range pfx-2026-03-15-us-e1 --force --region us-east-1
```
Kunal (platform): invalidation job queued; progress: 1200 keys invalidated so far. Logs show a small tail of decode errors being removed.
Maria (runtime): we should also enable read-through bypass for >2s latched entries so gateway falls back to direct KV read rather than returning 502s. I'm toggling that now.
Kunal (platform): `redwoodctl feature toggle --feature read_through_bypass --enable --scope us-east-1`
deploy-bot: feature toggled. read_through_bypass enabled in us-east-1.
Maria (runtime): local dashboards: 5xx now ~0.7% and trending down. Error traces show the NPE source is the decode path when pointer bytes are zero-length. Root cause hypothesis: compaction checkpoint wrote sparse tombstones that left zero-length pointer entries.
Jamie (oncall-sre): agreed. Keep this thread for live updates. Action items captured: immediate mitigations done (fallback, scale, prefetch off, invalidate, read-through bypass). Next actions: rebuild affected prefix index from snapshot, add precompact checks, add checksum validation to compaction job. Maria/Kunal own.
Zoe (support): updating AcmeCorp and bumped priority. They asked for ETA on full fix.
Maria (runtime): ETA for rebuild depends on shard size; planning snapshot rebuild for the worst shard in us-east-1, estimate 2-3 hours to rebuild and rehydrate; low risk but will do in maintenance window unless customers demand earlier. I'll prepare PR with compaction safety checks.
Kunal (platform): started shard rebuild for pfx-2026-03-15-us-e1 in background. Monitoring copy throughput. If replication lag > 60s we'll throttle.
Jamie (oncall-sre): quick status at 00:46 UTC: traffic normalized enough to remove pager. 5xx at 0.5% last 5m. Keeping oncall handover until rebuild completes. Postmortem owners: Maria (runtime) & Kunal (platform). Follow-ups: add canary for compaction job, add automatic fallback in routing for cache decode errors, add alert for prefix-cache decode-error rate.
Maria (runtime): creating incident ticket INC-2026-1795 with timeline and mitigation steps.
Zoe (support): posted customer update to AcmeCorp: temporary routing applied; we expect full recovery once rebuild completes. :coffee:
Jamie (oncall-sre): thanks team. If anything regresses we re-open pager. Closing live thread but leaving this thread pinned for handoff notes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): gateway 5xx reduced to acceptable levels. Root-cause suspected: compaction checkpoint produced malformed prefix entries causing shadow-read decode failures and downstream NPEs. See followups in INC-2026-1795. :white_check_mark:
